business_scope.primary_industry_name: Retail Sale via Internet - Marketplace FBA Store

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Colombia (Unitary National Jurisdiction; S.A.S. legal regime governed nationally by Ley 1258 de 2008)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Continental Napoleonic tradition; commercial and corporate matters regulated by the Código de Comercio and administered by the Superintendencia de Sociedades)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Colombia-United States Trade Promotion Agreement (FTA) with investment chapter (in force 2012)
Colombia-Spain BIT (in force 2008) and Income and Capital Tax Treaty (in force 2008)
Colombia-Chile Income and Capital Tax Treaty (in force 2009)
Colombia-Mexico Income and Capital Tax Treaty (in force 2013)
Colombia-South Korea Income and Capital Tax Treaty (in force 2014) and FTA (in force 2016)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 526 de 1999 (UIAF creation and AML/CFT framework); Ley 1121 de 2006; Ley 1621 de 2013; Decreto 1068 de 2015 (Part 3, Title 4); Decreto 830 de 2021 and Resolución UIAF 153 de 2021 (Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales - RUB); Circular Reglamentaria 008 de 2024 of the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (PEP and sanctions risk management rules)
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access (RUB data is accessible solely to UIAF, DIAN, Superintendencia de Sociedades, fiscal authorities and other competent supervisory bodies; it is not in the public domain)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney for Incorporation (Poder Especial para la Constitución de la S.A.S.)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public of the shareholders' home jurisdiction; if no notary of record exists, Colombian Consul in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or Colombian Consular Legalization for countries not party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of passport or national ID of each direct shareholder, UBO and designated legal representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport authority / civil registry of the home country
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille, followed by certified Spanish translation for the Chamber of Commerce and RUB file

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Existence, Good Standing and Corporate Registry Extract of any foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-country company registry (e.g., Companies House, Secretary of State filing office)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille, followed by certified Spanish translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter or economic activity evidence for UBO due diligence file
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization plus Hague Apostille (retained in the internal AML/KYC transaction file)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-registration screening of all shareholders, UBOs (5% or greater), directors, legal representatives and authorized signatories against OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UK HMT Sanctions List, UIAF national lists, and CONPES designations. PEP identification must cover Colombian and foreign PEPs plus their family members and close associates; any positive match triggers enhanced due diligence, senior-management approval, and a Suspicious Transaction Report (ROS) to UIAF when warranted under Circular 008/2024. Re-screening is required at least every six months and upon any material change in ownership; no sector exemption exists for FBA e-commerce settlements via Amazon Pay, Stripe, or Airwallex.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) - www.rues.org.co (name reservation and homonimia search conducted through the local Cámara de Comercio, e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá at www.ccb.org.co)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be expressed in Spanish script (Latin alphabet); foreign or invented words are accepted only if transliterated phonetically and presented with the mandatory 'S.A.S.' suffix. The name must not be identical or confusingly similar (graphic or phonetic similarity) to names already registered in the same Chamber of Commerce registry; the RUES homonimia search is the binding pre-clearance instrument.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Banking and financial terms ('Banco', 'Fiduciaria', 'Fondo de Inversión', 'Aseguradora', 'Corredor de Bolsa', 'Leasing') - require prior written approval of the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia
State and official terms ('Nacional', 'Presidencia', 'Ministerio', 'Gobernación', 'Alcaldía', 'Policía Nacional') - reserved for public entities
Solidarity economy terms ('Cooperativa', 'Fondo de Empleados') - require prior approval of the Superintendencia de la Economía Solidaria
Third-party distinctive trademark terms (including global e-commerce marks such as 'Amazon') - rejected unless the trademark owner files a written coexistence authorization
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection, the applicant may immediately file a new homonimia application with a modified name. To contest an adverse registry decision, the applicant must file a recurso de reposición before the same Chamber of Commerce within 10 business days of notification, and subsidiarily a recurso de apelación before the Superintendencia de Sociedades within 10 business days of confirmation. The appeal must set out the statutory grounds allegedly violated by the registrar and attach the RUES search certificate. If the rejection is based on a third-party trademark, the applicant must obtain and file the trademark owner's coexistence or prior authorization before refiling.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible for a low-risk FBA e-commerce S.A.S. provided the virtual office contract guarantees a physical address for service of process and mail reception within the jurisdiction of the Chamber of Commerce of registration, and is backed by a registered commercial address provider. A 'letterbox' shell without any local substance is not acceptable; DIAN substance rules require at least minimal local economic nexus, management oversight capacity and local books and records.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low: estimated annual probability below 5% for the Low-Risk Standard tier with no physical inventory in Colombia. Chamber of Commerce address verification is normally ex officio or complaint-driven; DIAN performs remote VAT/invoice cross-checks rather than targeted on-site visits for marketplace FBA models.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name clearance and homonimia certificate (1 proposed name via RUES)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Cámara de Comercio (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registry tariff (approximately COP 10,000 per name)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting of S.A.S. private incorporation document and bylaws (estatutos), including management and UBO clauses
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark: USD 250 to USD 500 flat fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization of signatures on the private incorporation document (autenticación de firmas)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary Public (Notaría) in the registration city
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notary tariff (approximately COP 50,000 to COP 80,000)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Chamber of Commerce registration of incorporation document and merchant registration (matrícula mercantil)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff scaled to declared capital; minimum band for assets below approximately COP 12.8 million plus registration form fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Hague Apostille certification of 4 foreign documents (passports, POA, corporate shareholder certificate, bank letter)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory fee of approximately COP 30,000 to COP 40,000 per apostille; apostille does not expire, underlying documents retain 90-day validity

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified Spanish translation of foreign documents (5 pages average)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market rate of USD 20 to USD 30 per page including translator stamp

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: RUB (Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales) initial UBO report preparation and filing
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: No statutory filing fee; professional compliance service at market benchmark of USD 50 to USD 150

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Virtual office and registered address (annual service with mail acceptance and service of process)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registered virtual office provider in Bogotá
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market rate of USD 18 to USD 25 per month

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-incorporation AML/KYC and sanctions screening file (PEP, OFAC, UN, EU, UK, UIAF lists) and risk assessment
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Compliance consultancy or corporate service provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark of USD 100 to USD 300 flat; mandated by the corporate AML/CFT compliance program under Ley 526 de 1999

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedades por Acciones Simplificadas), Articles 1-27 and 45; Código de Comercio (Decreto 410 de 1971), Articles 110-128 and 353-372; Decreto 1074 de 2015, Single Regulatory Decree for Commerce, Industry and Tourism, Part II, Title I, Chapter 2, as applicable.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio principal (local Chamber of Commerce), through the Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES); administrative oversight by the Superintendencia de Sociedades.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución de la S.A.S. (private incorporation instrument) or Escritura Pública (public deed) where real-estate contributions are involved, filed in the Mercantile Registry and RUES.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital is required by Colombian law. The incorporators freely fix the authorized, subscribed, and paid-in capital in the bylaws. Deferred cash contributions may be scheduled but the payment period cannot exceed two years. Colombian law does not require a blocked escrow account for S.A.S. formation; cash contributions are evidenced by bank transfer or deposit statements which must be retained in the corporate accounting file.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION. The founding shareholders, acting as the supreme corporate body under Law 1258 of 2008, resolve: (1) The subscription of shares in the incorporation instrument is ratified and share certificates are issued to subscribers. (2) The registered office is adopted at the address stated in the bylaws. (3) [Legal Representative] is appointed legal representative and [Alternate] alternate legal representative with full corporate powers. (4) The legal representative is authorized to register the company with the Cámara de Comercio, obtain the RUT/NIT from DIAN, open bank accounts, and complete municipal licensing formalities. (5) All prior powers are revoked.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio through the Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the proposed corporate name and a preference order of up to three alternatives through the RUES pre-registration tool. Pay the applicable name-search tariff if charged. Obtain the Certificate of Homonimia confirming that no identical or confusingly similar name is registered in the same territorial chamber.
required_dossiers: RUES name-search request form
Proposed corporate name and corporate purpose
Founder identification or existing tax number, if available
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused, file a reconsideration with the Cámara de Comercio or select the next reserved name. No substantive penalty applies if the correction is made before incorporation submission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of the Incorporation Instrument and First Corporate Resolution
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: The founders, a Colombian notary where notarial form is required, and the Cámara de Comercio
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Spanish-language S.A.S. bylaws and the First Board Resolution. Have the founding shareholders execute either a private incorporation document or, when real estate or registered in-kind assets are contributed, a public deed before a Notaría. Include the registered-office address, authorized/subscribed/paid-in capital, share classes, governance, officer appointments, and the corporate purpose covering ISIC 4791 internet retail and Amazon FBA marketplace sales.
required_dossiers: Draft bylaws (Documento Privado de Constitución or Escritura Pública)
First Board Resolution minutes
Passports or national IDs and tax identification data of all shareholders
Proof of in-kind assets or valuation reports, if any
Address of registered office and owner consent, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary or chamber identifies formal defects, execute a corrective amendment or addendum, legalize signatures as required, and resubmit the corrected instrument before the registration deadline.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Merchant Registration with the Cámara de Comercio
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio principal / RUES
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the executed incorporation instrument, the First Board Resolution, and the completed Registration of Legal Entities form to the Chamber. Pay the registration and matriculation tariffs. After approval, the Chamber issues the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal, which evidences the entity's legal existence and the powers of the legal representative.
required_dossiers: Incorporation instrument (private document or public deed)
Original First Board Resolution
Certificate of Homonimia
Completed RUES registration form for legal entities
Payment receipt for chamber tariffs
Consent or lease evidencing availability of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the chamber issues a rejection or asks to correct defects, remedy the specific observation, resubmit the corrected instrument, and pay any rectification fee if applicable. Legal representatives may ratify signatures before a notary when the chamber requests legalization.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration with DIAN and Issuance of NIT
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Using the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal, complete the Registro Único Tributario (RUT) through DIAN's electronic channels. Obtain the NIT once the RUT is active. Declare the taxpayer as responsible for income tax and, as applicable, VAT and national consumption tax; include ISIC activity 4791 and the commercial model of cross-border marketplace e-commerce. Request habilitación for electronic invoicing (Facturación Electrónica).
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal issued by the Cámara de Comercio
Certified copy of the bylaws and First Board Resolution
NIT or passport of the legal representative and each shareholder, as requested
Registered-office address and contact data
RUT request and economic-activity identification form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RUT application is blocked or suspended because of inconsistent personal or address data, correct the underlying data at the Cámara de Comercio, obtain an updated Registry Certificate, and submit a RUT rectification. DIAN decisions may be appealed through the recurso de reconsideración or the regional DIAN proceeding, as applicable.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Bank Account Activation and Capital Contribution Evidence
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Colombian supervised banking or multipurpose financial entity
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a corporate checking or savings account in the company's name. Deposit the paid-in cash capital, if any, and record deferred subscription balances as a corporate liability in the subscribed-capital ledger. Obtain bank certificates or vouchers evidencing the capital payment. Colombian law does not require an escrow or blocked account for S.A.S. cash contributions.
required_dossiers: RUT and NIT
Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
Bylaws and First Board Resolution naming the legal representative
Identification of the authorized signers and beneficial owners
Bank KYC and compliance forms
Proof of registered-office address, such as a utility bill or lease
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If bank compliance raises a query, provide the Registro de Beneficiario Final declaration, original company documents, or a recently issued legalization certificate. If the bank persists, the company may open the account with another supervised financial institution without losing the corporate registration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Municipal or district authorities, including the Secretaría de Hacienda, Oficina de Planeación, Cuerpo Oficial de Bomberos, ARL and Ministry of Labor system
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register with the municipal Impuesto de Industria y Comercio (ICA) registry in each municipality where commercial or warehousing activity occurs. If a physical office or fulfillment/warehouse is used, obtain the land-use compatibility concept (concepto de uso del suelo), request fire-safety inspection and certification, and implement the SG-SST occupational safety program with ARL affiliation. For pure marketplace operations with no physical establishment, only the registered-office municipal registry and tax registration apply.
required_dossiers: RUT and NIT
Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
Lease or title documents for any physical premises
Certified floor plan and structural load note, where racking or mezzanines will be installed
Fire-safety application form and inspection checklist
SG-SST documentation and ARL affiliation evidence
Duly completed municipal ICA registration form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the municipal or fire-safety application is rejected, rectify structural, safety, or zoning deficiencies, file a derecho de petición or the applicable administrative reconsideration under Ley 1437 de 2011, and request a reinspection. A fresh Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal is used to update municipal tax registries if the rejection was data-related.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable — no industrial licensing board, industrial license or manufacturing permit is required for ISIC 4791 (Retail Sale via Internet / Amazon FBA general) in Colombia. Consumer-protection oversight for e-commerce rests with the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC).
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable — no separate sectoral operating license. The only mandatory registrations are the Matrícula Mercantil, the municipal Impuesto de Industria y Comercio registration, and, where a physical workplace is opened, the applicable land-use and fire-safety clearances.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA); local Corporación Autónoma Regional (CAR) for zoning, discharges and non-mandatory environmental permits
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt/Registration — online retail and general non-industrial fulfillment warehousing do not fall under the mandatory environmental-licensing list of Decree 1076 of 2015. A permit is required only if the operation generates regulated point-source wastewater discharges, uses private water sources, or handles hazardous waste outside municipal collection.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: If applicable, wastewater discharges must comply with Resolución 0631 de 2015 parameters; atmospheric emissions must comply with Resolución 2254 de 2017 ambient air-quality thresholds; hazardous waste generation, storage, transport and disposal must comply with Decree 4741 de 2005 and the waste-manifest rules of Resolución 1407 de 2018.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire-safety inspection and certification by the local Cuerpo Oficial de Bomberos; structural load verification and engineering clearance for racking, mezzanines or warehouse fixtures; municipal concept of land use for any physical premises; SG-SST occupational health and safety program with ARL affiliation under Resolución 0312 de 2019; workplace-occupancy clearance is required before employees or operators begin activities.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: DIAN - Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (Sede Electrónica: www.dian.gov.co; transactional portal: MUISCA)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity must obtain a Colombian NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria) by filing an application with DIAN through a locally appointed legal representative (apoderado) under a notarized power of attorney. The representative executes the pre-registration in MUISCA, obtains the NIT, then completes the RUT (Registro Único Tributario) enrolment to update tax status, e-invoicing qualification, and economic activity classification (e.g., ISIC 4791). Non-resident shareholders are allowed; no minimum capital is required for the S.A.S.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Colombia has no check-the-box election. The S.A.S. is automatically a domestic corporation subject to Colombian income tax on its worldwide income as a separate entity. Eligible taxpayers may elect under Law 1943/2018 and Decree 1625/2016 to apply either the standard corporate income tax regime or the SAR (Simplified Taxation Regime) where turnover limits and activity tests are met. No domestic hybrid mismatch election is available.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No general VAT registration threshold: every individual or entity engaged in selling taxable goods or services in Colombia is required to register in the RUT before commencing activities. A reduced threshold applies only to certain informal retailers; for standard SAS e-commerce and marketplace operations, immediate RUT registration is mandatory.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory e-invoicing (factura electrónica) is phased in by DIAN. The SAS must issue electronic sales invoices through ICT providers approved by DIAN. The invoice XML must be validated, transmitted, and registered with DIAN in near real-time via web services. Invoices must include CUFE or CUDE code, DIAN assigned validation status, and QR code. Debit/credit notes must follow the same clearance mandate. Exports and FBA marketplace sales require electronic export invoice and electronic invoice with customs export annexes.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of physical goods from Colombia are subject to VAT rate 0% (excluded from VAT) if they are legally exported in accordance with the Colombian Customs Statute and the goods leave the country within the allowed timeframe. Services provided exclusively for use outside Colombia, including digital marketplace support services, may be zero-rated as export services where the beneficiary is not located in Colombia and the requirements of Decree 1625/2016 and DIAN Concept 01745/2018 are met. For cross-border e-commerce under an Amazon FBA model, physical goods exported from Colombia qualify for 0% VAT provided the exporter receives the export proceeds within the statutory exchange settlement periods and all customs formalities are completed.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (DEX) accepted by DIAN
Bill of Lading or Airwaybill evidencing definitive export
Commercial invoice issued in the name of the foreign buyer

Inward Remittance Certificate (Recibo Electrónico de Compensación) issued by Colombian bank, or certificate/dispatch document proving foreign currency entering through authorized foreign exchange market
FBA shipment, warehouse receiving documentation, and customs broker proof for goods delivered to Amazon fulfilment centers
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN may disregard zero-rating where export documentation, foreign exchange repatriation, or service-use tests are incomplete or contradictory. In fraud cases, the authority reverses the 0% treatment, demands the 19% VAT plus default interest, and imposes penalties of up to 200% of the omitted tax amount under Article 648 of the Colombian Tax Statute, along with income tax recapture and potential criminal liability for tax evasion (Law 1762/2015, Article 24). Exporters must retain the complete electronic dossier for at least 6 years for audit and potential clawback procedures.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia (the central bank of the Republic of Colombia), acting jointly with the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC) as financial-market supervisor and with the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Tourism (MINCIT) and the DIAN customs/foreign-trade agency as co-regulators of cross-border flows. The foreign-exchange regime is set out in Law 9 of 1991, Decree 1735 of 1993, Decree 2555 of 2010, and Circular Reglamentaria DCIN-83 of Banco de la República.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Colombian peso (COP) operates under a managed free-floating exchange-rate regime. Current-account operations — export collections, import payments, services, royalties, and dividend/profit remittances — are freely convertible in the official exchange market, but all export proceeds must be channeled through authorized intermediaries of the foreign-exchange market (IMCs) or a compensation account registered with Banco de la República. Capital-account operations — foreign direct investment (FDI), external loans, and portfolio inflows — are also convertible, subject to registration with Banco de la República through the IMC at the time of channeling. Profit remittance abroad is lawful where (i) the paid-in capital was registered as foreign investment, (ii) distributable earnings were approved by the shareholders' meeting and the Colombian CIT/withholding obligations were satisfied, and (iii) the remittance is executed through an IMC with the corresponding exchange declaration. The operative hurdles are the documentary burden of FDI registration, source-of-funds verification for offshore shareholders, and the strict prohibition on settling export-generated flows through unregistered channels.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Pursuant to Decree 1735 of 1993 and Circular Reglamentaria DCIN-83, export proceeds from goods must be reintegrated (brought into the exchange market) within six (6) months from the export declaration (DMA), extendable to twelve (12) months with Banco de la República prior authorization; service-export proceeds must be reintegrated within six (6) months from the provision of the service. A one-hundred-percent (100%) channeling obligation applies to the foreign currency generated by exports; however, the exporter is not necessarily required to convert the foreign currency into pesos because proceeds may lawfully be applied to extinguish the exporter's own foreign-currency liabilities (e.g., import payments or FBA logistics obligations) through a declared compensation. Amazon FBA settlements represent aggregated export collections that must be mapped to the underlying DMAs and entered in the 'reintegro' declaration filed by the IMC. Failure to reintegrate on time, under-declaration, or use of unregistered offshore wallets for export collections subjects the S.A.S. to exchange fine procedures, customs/DIAN penalties, and exclusion from the IMC relationship.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (COP/USD corporate current account with FX transformation desk and foreign-trade advisory)
Operational Account (corporate current account with S.A.S. digital onboarding and international wire channel)
Operational Account (streamlined foreign-investor onboarding with video-assisted KYC and FX forward lines)
Operational Account (merchant and e-commerce account package with virtual POS capabilities)
Capital Escrow Account (dedicated paid-in share-capital sub-account supporting FDI registration and reintegro control)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium-High with material legal constraints. Stripe may be used as the Colombian-incorporated S.A.S.'s e-commerce collection/payment gateway for card transactions, settling in COP through local acquiring banks, but it is not an authorized Intermediario del Mercado Cambiario (IMC) and cannot lawfully replace the statutory channel for Amazon FBA export proceeds. Airwallex is a non-resident global EMI: appropriate for non-FX working-capital disbursements (cloud services, contractor payments), but unusable as the sole collection point for export settlements. Payoneer, frequently used by Amazon sellers, may serve only as a complementary wallet whose balances are swept to a local Tier-1 IMC or a compensation account registered with Banco de la República. Nequi and Daviplata (SEDPEs) offer local e-wallet rails with transactional limits and cannot function as corporate treasury accounts. Recommended design: the local Tier-1 IMC account is the legal anchor for reintegro; Stripe, Payoneer, and Airwallex remain auxiliary rails excluded from export-reintegration unless a compensation-account registration is in place.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For a non-resident-owned S.A.S., the legal representative (representante legal) or a formally appointed attorney-in-fact must appear physically at the bank branch in Colombia for signature authentication and biometric verification during initial corporate onboarding; fully remote opening is not consistently available for foreign-owned accounts. Directors residing abroad may be onboarded using apostilled powers of attorney, certified passport copies, proof of tax residence from the home jurisdiction, and a video-conference interview with the compliance officer; however, at least one person with signatory authority over the account must be reachable in Colombia or represented through a registered local agent. The S.A.S. must present the current Chamber of Commerce certificate (Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal) issued within 30 days, the internal bylaws, the beneficial-ownership (RUBF) declaration, and, where foreign capital is paid, the share-subscription and capital-payment minutes.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident beneficial owners with no local nexus and insufficient documentation of the source of funds for the paid-in equity contribution.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized incorporation deed and capital-payment certificate; recent Chamber of Commerce excerpt; RUBF beneficial-owner filing with DIAN; source-of-funds statement signed by each shareholder; apostilled passport copies and home-jurisdiction tax residence certificates; bank reference letters; and a sworn statement of purpose describing the Amazon FBA business model.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume, low-value marketplace settlements (Amazon FBA) triggering transaction-monitoring alerts and potential misclassification of export proceeds as unidentified credits.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Amazon seller verification certificate and Remittance Balance Statements covering at least twelve settlement cycles; reconciliation mapping each settlement to its corresponding DMA export declaration; DIAN exporter (RUT) registration and customs broker engagement letters; and an accountant-prepared report tracing each weekly settlement to declared export reintegros.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Use of offshore EMIs/wallets (Airwallex, Payoneer, Stripe) as settlement points for Amazon collections, creating the appearance of an unregistered parallel FX channel.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Registered compensation account agreement (Cuenta de Compensación) with the designated IMC where applicable; a treasury policy confirming that EMI balances are swept only to the local Tier-1 account; Amazon disbursement routing instructions naming the Colombian bank; and the relevant Declaración de Cambio forms evidencing each reintegro.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Insufficient economic substance and commercial rationale of the S.A.S. for an e-commerce intermediary (interposition, round-tripping, or shell-indicia risk).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Amazon Marketplace Seller Agreement and store identity evidence; FBA inbound shipment records and warehouse receipts; electronic invoicing (facturación electrónica) history to DIAN; employment/contractor records of the local team in Colombia; office or co-working lease; and the shareholder-approved operational budget and business plan.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant sequence for a non-resident capital contribution: (i) the shareholder executes the S.A.S. capital-payment minutes and, if demanded by the bank, a notarized contribution act; (ii) funds are remitted by SWIFT MT103 from the shareholder's own bank account (clearly identifying the investor as remitter) to the S.A.S.'s Tier-1 IMC account in Colombia, denominated in COP or USD; (iii) the IMC files the Declaración de Cambio under the foreign-direct-investment capital category and registers the investment with Banco de la República's international-investment records; (iv) after crediting, the bank issues the exchange certificate for the UBO/audit file. Purpose codes should reference 'Inversión extranjera directa — aporte de capital'; the wire message must not commingle personal expenses or third-party transactions. Verification package: MT103 confirmation, exchange declaration, updated Chamber of Commerce excerpt showing paid capital, and the shareholder registry book.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For operating disbursements, the S.A.S. should use the following rails: (i) SWIFT MT103 telegraphic transfers in USD/COP from the local IMC account to Chinese, U.S., or regional suppliers, with the invoice and import declaration (Declaración de Importación) referenced in the wire narrative; (ii) sight commercial letters of credit (L/C at sight) issued by the Tier-1 bank for high-value FBA inventory, protecting against documentary risk; (iii) direct card-based or account-to-account payouts to Amazon for FBA logistics, storage, and advertising, which are treated as service/import payments and must be reconciled against Amazon charges; and (iv) exchange-market offset (compensation) where USD export proceeds are applied to extinguish supplier obligations without passing through COP, declared as compensation to the IMC. Amazon's net settling of logistics fees against product revenue is commercially accepted, but the netting must be documented and, where it affects export reintegro, declared as a compensation within the exchange market.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable COP/USD foreign-exchange forwards (forward sobre TRM) contracted with SFC-authorized banks/IMCs, with position limits tied to the underlying Amazon USD receivables and reported to the FX derivative registry.
COP/USD cross-currency swaps (swap de moneda) with local Tier-1 banks for rolling USD settlement balances into COP operating liquidity.
Exchange-traded USD/COP futures and options through licensed Grupo Bolsa (BVC) broker-dealers, used for hedge accounting of committed FBA payables.

Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on USD/COP with foreign counterparties, permitted only as economic hedges of export receivables, with settlement of any net amounts declared through the local IMC and evidenced in the treasury file.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil (Commercial Registry Renewal)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio (Chamber of Commerce) of registered domicile
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late surcharge of 0.75% per month or fraction of the renewal fee; sustained non-renewal triggers registration suspension, administrative strike-off, and possible company liquidation.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Acta de Asamblea y Estados Financieros Anuales (Shareholders' Meeting Minutes and Annual Financial Statements)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio (Chamber of Commerce) – Registro Mercantil
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Shareholders' approval by March 31; minutes filed with Chamber within 10 days after meeting
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines of up to 200 SMMLV (~USD 65,000) for non-filing; inability to lawfully dissolve or merge; restrictions on accessing commercial registry certificates.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Declaración Anual de Renta (Corporate Income Tax Return)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually for preceding fiscal year; filing window set by DIAN resolution, typically February–April
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late penalty of 5% of tax due per month or fraction, capped at 100%; late interest; potential criminal liability for willful non-compliance.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Información Exógena Anual (Annual Third-Party Transaction Report)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually for preceding calendar year; due by mid-February per DIAN resolution
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fine of 1% of unprovided or incorrect values, or 15,000 UVT (~USD 175,000), whichever is higher; correction opportunity limited to two years.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Reporte de Beneficiarios Finales (UBO Annual Confirmation)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: UAFE (Unidad de Administración de la Información Financiera) via DIAN authorized electronic channel
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines up to 50 SMMLV (~USD 16,000) per violation; possible suspension of right to hold company offices; administrative sanctions on the company.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Compulsory statutory audit (Revisor Fiscal) when prior-year gross income exceeds 3,000 SMMLV (~COP 3.9B / USD 975k) OR total assets exceed 5,000 SMMLV (~COP 6.5B / USD 1.6M); otherwise optional unless expressly required in bylaws.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS (NIIF) as adopted in Colombia; small and medium entities apply NIIF para PYMES (IFRS for SMEs); full IFRS for larger entities; financial statements prepared in Colombian pesos (COP).

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Annual UBO confirmation mandatory even if no shareholding transfer during the year; report must be filed with UAFE by September 15 using DIAN's electronic system; any shareholding change during the year must be updated within 30 days of the transfer.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 400 - USD 1,500 per year (if mandatory or voluntarily appointed)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No statutory regional tax holiday applies to e-commerce/FBA activity. Available in consequence: 175% deduction for qualifying R&D investment (80% deduction in relevant cases, subject to DIAN certification); tax loss carry-forward without statutory expiration, capped at 25% of taxable income per year; VAT (19%) creditable against ICA? Actually no.
